summary: ClearOne, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing a $200,000 non-interest-bearing Loan Agreement with First Finance Ltd., effective October 7, 2026 and executed October 14, 2026. Proceeds are designated for general working capital; repayment timing is to be mutually agreed in writing, and the loan is prepayable without penalty. Customary Events of Default include a five-business-day payment cure and automatic acceleration on bankruptcy or receivership. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation; no board recommendation, advisor, shareholder vote, or deal terms apply. Watch covenant compliance and liquidity.
